root_idea.summary: The root centers on settling after disturbance into stillness, calm, and ease.
root_idea.development: The evidence connects making or becoming low and still with inner tranquility, reliance that brings reassurance, and settled residence; these related branches remain distinct in particular derived forms.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form XII perfect citation form.
Displayed under the singular masculine active-participle citation form.
This group is the feminine active-participle inflection of مُطْمَئِنّ and is represented under the shared citation form.

senses.definition: To become still, tranquil, reassured, or at ease after disturbance; to find inner peace.
senses.usage_conditions: Used especially of the heart, soul, or person becoming free from disquiet. Contextual renderings include becoming secure, satisfied, or at rest.

senses.definition: To become settled in mind through trust or reliance on something, and so to become content with it.
senses.usage_conditions: The construction with إِلَى or بِـ expresses the thing relied upon or accepted as a source of mental ease; this includes becoming content with a worldly life or other object.

senses.definition: Tranquil, at rest, calm, or secure in mind; inwardly reassured or content.
senses.usage_conditions: An active participle describing a person, heart, or soul. It may be rendered according to context as content, satisfied, secure, or peacefully settled.

senses.definition: Of the soul, tranquil through belief and submissive or humble to its Lord.
senses.usage_conditions: This specialized characterization belongs to the Quranic expression النَّفْسُ الْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ; the associated description is a soul not given to commanding evil, rather than a general restriction on every occurrence of the participle.

senses.definition: Trusting or relying on something so as to be at rest in mind.
senses.usage_conditions: The construction with بِـ or إِلَى identifies what provides the subject with reassurance or settled confidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bend or lower the back, and similarly to lower another thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A physical lowering construction; the hamzated and unhamzated forms are reported together in this usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause a thing to become still, restful, quiet, or calm.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Transitive causative use, distinct from the intransitive state of becoming tranquil.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be at rest from an affair or event.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with مِنْ to express relief or cessation of disturbance from an affair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To stoop, bend oneself down, or lower oneself.
To become lowly, humble, or submissive.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use explicitly marked as such; it is not imposed on the ordinary physical sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of land or ground, to become low or depressed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Physical description of the surface or level of the ground.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To remain, stay, or settle in a place and take it as a home.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction with بِـ identifies the place chosen as a settled abode.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To desist from what one has been doing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with عَمَّا to mark the action or practice from which one desists; this is a specialized figurative use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A depression or low place in the ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete nominal use referring to a low area or hollow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Stillness, rest, ease, quietness, calmness, tranquility, or freedom from disquietude.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Nominal designation of a state of calm, distinct from the physical sense of a depression in the ground.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place of depression or lowness in the land or ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete noun for a low or depressed place; it is distinct in form from مُطْمَئِنّ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thing to which one trusts or upon which one relies so as to become at rest in mind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The prepositional construction identifies the trusted or relied-upon object.
A concrete spatial use of this headword, separate from its Quran-attested active-participle sense of inward tranquility.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who takes a place in the earth or a country as a home or settled abode.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A residence-related use describing settled habitation rather than mental calm.

cautions: The Quranic renderings “satisfied,” “secure,” “reassured,” and “at rest” are contextual realizations of the tranquility and settled-confidence branches, not automatically separate senses.
The humility, submission, and moral characterization attached to النَّفْسُ الْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ are specific to that Quranic expression and should not be generalized to every occurrence of مُطْمَئِنّ.
